hypotheses.title: Inconsistent Icon Styling Between Navigation and 'Favoritos' Section
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Favoritos' icon in the bottom navigation bar (heart icon) appears to have a different visual style (fill color, stroke weight) compared to the heart icon displayed within the 'Seu coração ainda está leve' section.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: All heart icons throughout the application should maintain consistent styling to ensure visual uniformity and brand consistency.
hypotheses.oracle: Open the page in Chrome 120. Inspect both heart icons using developer tools. Verify that their fill color, stroke weight, and overall appearance are identical. If they differ, this constitutes a failure.

hypotheses.title: 'Abrir Favoritos' Button Redundancy with Bottom Navigation
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button is present in the promotional section despite the 'Favoritos' icon already being prominently displayed and functional in the bottom navigation bar.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Redundant controls should be avoided to prevent user confusion and streamline the interface. The presence of a duplicate action may indicate an unnecessary element or potential design flaw.
hypotheses.oracle: Open the page in Firefox 120. Attempt to navigate to the 'Favoritos' section using both the bottom navigation icon and the 'Abrir meus favoritos' button. Verify that both actions lead to the same destination and provide identical functionality. If they are functionally equivalent, consider removing one of them.

hypotheses.title: Promotional Section Text Clarity
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The promotional text "Salve agora. Volte quando bater vontade." is somewhat ambiguous and may not clearly convey its purpose to all users. The accompanying explanation 'Use os favoritos para montar coleções pessoais e reencontrar rapidamente tudo o que chamou sua atenção' helps, but the initial phrase could be more direct.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Promotional text should be concise, clear, and immediately understandable to a broad audience. Ambiguous language can lead to user confusion or disengagement.
hypotheses.oracle: Open the page in Safari 17. Observe user reactions (e.g., eye tracking) to the promotional section. Conduct A/B testing with alternative phrasing for 'Salve agora. Volte quando bater vontade.' and measure click-through rates or other engagement metrics.
